response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) AS mean_diff FROM p) SELECT p.SEX, AVG(p.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(p.avg_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff, AVG(p.avg_diff / m.mean_diff) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean FROM p CROSS JOIN m GROUP BY p.SEX
